issue.title: Freshness-gated READY with NEW and ROTTEN review views
issue.description: The dashboard separates unconfirmed tasks into NEW, keeps confirmed and exempt tasks in READY, and links expired or returned confirmations to rotten.md, with matching live badges and one rotten vocabulary across human and machine views.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/freshness_gated_ready.md requests this work

issue.title: Add cached freshness buckets and matching dashboard models
issue.description: ledger-bucket: add the shared read-time bucket contract in bob-ledger-tools and bob-cli, memoize classification and config reads, gate the shared READY count, and implement availability-aware NEW/ROTTEN models and live refresh. Cover the partition, fallback, calendar boundaries, and performance; preserve v1 JSON state names until vocab-rotten. Follow the ledger-bucket section below.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/freshness_gated_ready.md defines phase ledger-bucket as one work unit

issue.title: Roll out NEW and ROTTEN views, badges, docs, and decisions
issue.description: dash-gating: add NEW between TODAY and PENDING, gate READY, rename freshness.md to rotten.md with RETURNED and ROTTEN groups, migrate links and badges, and publish the authorized decision/glossary updates. Deploy the plugin and vault changes together and verify the actual rendered views. Follow the dash-gating section below, including the two-week trial and rollout checks.

issue.title: Finish the rotten vocabulary and versioned contract migration
issue.description: vocab-rotten: rename freshness-specific machine state/count/config names in Rust and JavaScript, publish bob freshness JSON schema 2, and support the old budget key with a deprecation lint for one release. Update every freshness consumer and conformance test, preserve the bucket contract and unrelated stale terminology, then release and verify the final integration. Follow the vocab-rotten section below.
